chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Musa ibn Ja'far al-Mada'ini, from Ibrahim ibn Isma'il ibn Dawud, who said:

I asked al-Rida (peace be upon him) about fasting, and he said: 'Three days in the month: Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday.' I said: 'Indeed, our companions fast on Wednesday between two Thursdays.' He said: 'There is no objection to that, and there is no objection to Thursday between two Wednesdays.'

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: There is no objection / It is permissible

ai.seo_question: What are the recommended days for voluntary monthly fasting according to Imam al-Rida (AS)?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Al-Istibsar*, Imam al-Rida (AS) identifies Wednesday, Thursday, and Friday as the optimal days for voluntary monthly fasting, reflecting the pre-Islamic Arab custom of the *Ayyam al-Beed* (White Days). He explicitly validates the prevalent practice of the companions who fasted on Wednesdays (between two Thursdays) or Thursdays (between two Wednesdays), demonstrating the jurisprudential flexibility (*ikhtiyar*) within Shia tradition regarding the selection of these specific days for *Sawm al-Tatawwu'*.
